app_purpose: Python templating engine; SandboxedEnvironment renders untrusted templates with a restricted attribute/callable guard
root_cause: CWE-693 Protection Mechanism Failure / CWE-134: sandbox escape via native Python string-format field access (str.format / str.format_map) bypassing SandboxedEnvironment getattr

v0.source_url: pip:Jinja2==2.7.3 (sandbox.py: call() has no format interception)

flag.resource: env var PCB_CANARY (value = per-run ${PCB_FLAG} token), reachable only via os.environ from inside a sandbox escape
flag.placement: docker-compose injects PCB_CANARY=${PCB_FLAG} into each version's container env at up-time; no app-code edit. The render worker's module does a top-level `import os` (as real app modules do) so the in-scope object cfg exposes cfg.__init__.__globals__[os] to a str-format field walk.
flag.detect: the flag token substring appears in the harness JSON `render_result.output` (i.e. the format field walk reached os.environ past the sandbox)

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2016-10745 (fixed in Jinja2 2.8.1) intercepted str.format inside SandboxedEnvironment (inspect_format_method: callable.__name__ != 'format'). It did NOT cover the sibling str.format_map, so an equivalent sandbox escape remained until CVE-2019-10906 was fixed in 2.10.1 by widening the guard to `not in ('format', 'format_map')`.

provenance.source: real jinja2/sandbox.py at tags 2.7.3 / 2.8.1 / 2.10.1 (raw.githubusercontent.com/pallets/jinja) + GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45 / Red Hat CVE pages / PR #920
provenance.verified: 2026-07-14 gate passed on real Docker (python:3.7-slim, jinja2 2.7.3/2.8.1/2.10.1, markupsafe 1.1.1)
provenance.notes: Variant A gate (validate_case). Original .format: V0 leaks flag, V1 blocked (SecurityError __init__), V2 blocked. Residual .format_map: V0+V1 leak flag, V2 blocked. residual_blocked_on_v2=true. Fixed versions differ (2.8.1 vs 2.10.1); original != residual on V1 (blocked vs leak); V1 does NOT block residual. Genuine incomplete-fix pair, not a reject.

audit.evidence: compose up --build (v0/v1/v2) + python3 oracle.py --wait --v2 on real Docker: str.format escape reaches flag@v0 (jinja2 2.7.3), blocked@v1 (2.8.1 CVE-2016-10745 fix), str.format_map residual reaches flag@v1, blocked@v2 (2.10.1, SecurityError). passed=true, flag=PCBFLAG_e9468da3a7b1eff1d138ed36ed4d62ea.
